This is in furtherance to our intimations dated February

the Scheme of Amalgamation of Mandawewala Enterprises 
Limited ("Transferor Company") with AYM Syntex Limited ("Transferee Company" or "Company") and 
their respective shareholders ("Scheme"). 
We wish to inform you that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ("NCLT"), at 
its hearing held today has sanctioned the Scheme under Sections 230 to 232 read with Section 66 
and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. Further, in accordance with Clause 20 
of the Scheme, the Scheme has become effective upon sanctioning of the Scheme by the NCLT under 
sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Act. 
The order is awaited and the same shall be disclosed to the stock exchanges as and when received 
by the Company. 
We request you to take the above on record.
